items.title: Inbox no longer offers Messages switch mode
items.precondition: Signed in with access to /messages in an isolated runtime.
steps: Open /messages at desktop and narrow/mobile width.
Inspect the title action group and its keyboard focus order.
Activate New message and Message settings.
items.expected: Only New message and Message settings remain as inbox icon actions; no Moon/Sun or switch-mode accessible action is present, and both retained actions work.
items.evidence: 2026-08-18: user confirmed the local Messages test passed on localhost:5180; the inbox switch is absent and retained header actions work.

items.title: Messages follows the global appearance only
items.precondition: Signed in. A global appearance control is available through the existing application UI; browser storage can be inspected.
steps: Set the global application appearance to light and open /messages, then reload.
Set the global application appearance to dark and open /messages, then reload.
If socmed-messages-theme already exists in localStorage, set it to the opposite value and reload /messages.
items.expected: Messages matches the global appearance on every route and after reload. An obsolete socmed-messages-theme value has no visual effect and no Messages-only html class or route surface controls the result.
items.evidence: 2026-08-18: user confirmed the local Messages test passed on localhost:5180.

items.title: Conversation behavior and palettes remain available
items.precondition: Signed in with a conversation; use one default-theme thread and one saved custom conversation theme when available.
steps: Open each conversation and exercise search plus the Customize chat theme palette.
Change the global application appearance and revisit each thread.
Send no messages; verify selected colors, text, controls, and composer remain readable.
items.expected: Search and conversation palette behavior remain available. Default and custom threads are readable under either global appearance, without a Messages-specific palette-darkening mode.
items.evidence: 2026-08-18: user confirmed the local Messages test passed on localhost:5180.

items.title: Frontend quality gates and dead-reference audit
items.precondition: Frontend dependencies are installed and implementation is complete.
steps: Search production frontend source for MessagesTheme, messages-theme-, socmed-messages-theme, and a two-argument resolveConversationTheme call.
items.expected: No removed-feature references remain in production code, and every command exits successfully with no errors caused by this change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-18: production-source audit returned no MessagesTheme, messages-theme-, socmed-messages-theme, or two-argument resolveConversationTheme references. npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, lint, and build each exited 0.
items.notes: Lint emitted six pre-existing warnings outside changed files; Vite emitted its existing bundle-size advisory. The Constitution-documented root check:all command is not configured in package.json. No frontend test runner is configured; typecheck, lint, build, and isolated UI acceptance are the applicable gates.
